oomph.d: the activeness of an energetic personality

oosphere.d: a gamete; used especially of lower plants

oospore.d: a thick-walled sexual spore that develops from a fertilized oosphere in some algae and fungi

ootid.d: mature ovum after penetration by sperm but before the formation of a zygote
